name: gitrace
description: Pre-commit diff review and commit flow for macOS

scripts.postinstall: if [ -d node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app ]; then mv node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app node_modules/electron/dist/Gitrace.app; fi; if [ -d node_modules/electron/dist/Gitrace.app ]; then printf 'Gitrace.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron' > node_modules/electron/path.txt && plutil -replace CFBundleName -string Gitrace node_modules/electron/dist/Gitrace.app/Contents/Info.plist && plutil -replace CFBundleDisplayName -string Gitrace node_modules/electron/dist/Gitrace.app/Contents/Info.plist; fi
